import re

def parse_expenses(content):
    expenses = []
    lines = content.strip().split('\n')
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('- '):
            continue
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Pattern: <Payer> paid $<amount> for "<description>". Owed equally by <debtors>.
        m = re.match(r'(.+?) paid \$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) for "(.+?)"\. Owed equally by (.+)\.', line)
        if m:
            payer = m.group(1).strip()
            amount = float(m.group(2))
            description = m.group(3).strip()
            debtors_str = m.group(4).strip()
            # Split debtors by comma and "and"
            debtors = re.split(r',\s*|\s+and\s+', debtors_str)
            debtors = [d.strip() for d in debtors if d.strip()]
            expenses.append({
                'payer': payer,
                'amount': amount,
                'description': description,
                'debtors': debtors
            })
    return expenses
